top_choice_rationale: GLP-1 physiology and its active form is a mature discovery arc (Holst on secretion and actions, Mojsov on the active peptide, Drucker on receptor and proglucagon biology) that changed how type 2 diabetes and obesity are understood and treated, with confirmed outcome-trial benefit. The three-laureate allocation and the physiology-anchored citation avoid claiming sole priority for the peptide, although the contested Habener-group priority and the exclusion of Knudsen remain unresolved weaknesses. These do not outweigh the case, so the award is clearly preferable to no award.
